name: MiniMax H3
note: The checker's own quick-mode answers on fixed setups, in its own words. answerKind says what kind of answer each is (a RigCheck capacity estimate, a planning budget, a published route or recipe match); none is a measured setup. tier 'na' means unknown, not 'does not fit'. Conditions are part of the answer.

tiers.good: an answer without caveats of the checker's own kind; a limit stated in the answer (such as raising a Mac's GPU wired-memory limit, macLimit) still applies
tiers.caveats: an answer with caveats (part in system RAM, a planning estimate, an unverified peak or route)
tiers.no: does not fit, or below the smallest published figure
tiers.na: unknown: the checker covers no route or source for this hardware

answers.conditions: Matching recipes: SGLang Recipe A (lab): one card, DiT, text encoder and VAE streamed from the checkpoint file on an NVMe drive (Recipe A), BF16; measured at 864×480 (at the native 768P the cookbook says to use video_vae=24 if the decode runs out of memory, not measured); lab run with VRAM capped at 12 GiB and a simulated 32 GB host: shows the memory fits, not your card's speed; a real 32 GB machine re-reads the weights from disk on every step. H3-Base FL2VA, source recipe canvases only. Disk-streaming routes assume an NVMe drive. Host-RAM and lab assumptions remain in the full checker; full 2K needs an API.
